references.text: God warns Noah that it will rain for forty days and forty nights to destroy all life from the earth.
The flood was on the earth for forty days, and the waters rose and lifted the ark up from the ground.
After forty days, Noah opened the window he had made in the ark.
By these waters the world of that time was flooded and perished.
By faith Noah built an ark to save his household, having been warned by God about what had not yet been seen.
Those who were disobedient in Noah's days, when the ark was being built and only eight souls were saved through water.
Chronological connection in the flood narrative: 40 days of rain initiate the 150 days that the waters flood.
Chronological link: 40 days of rain start the process that lasts for 150 days before the waters recede.
Theological connection: The physical event (rain) is the execution of God's plan to destroy all living things.
